takes.text: In 1985, a gallon of gas cost about a dollar. Nobody had a cell phone. And at Costco, a hot dog and a soda cost one dollar and fifty cents. Today, gas costs three times as much. And the Costco hot dog? Still a dollar fifty. So how does a company that refuses to make money on its most famous product end up earning more than nine billion dollars in a single year?
